Ask the organism

A conversation with the organism, answered in this tab first. The code below is its own conversation region (a greeting, a question about the organism, thanks, a farewell), its exact reader, its word problem reader, its follow-up reader and the router to the cells it grew, the same files node bin/brain.mjs ask runs, copied byte for byte: no model, no token. A follow-up ("and germany?", "plus 9", "when was she born") is rewritten by rule into a question that stands alone, printed as "read as", and that is what is asked. A question no reader and no grown cell carries is posted once to the organism on the server (/api/ask); the tab's own refusal lines print under that answer, never guessed. Installed from the browser menu, the grown cells answer with no network.

how every answer prints its routeEvery answer prints how it was reached: route (which path answered), provenance (native: the conversation region; exact: computed with BigInt rationals, never rounded; grown: a cell the organism grew; memory; model), model (none: no language model was called, or the provider and model the server called), and its clock: a tab answer prints the nanoseconds per ask measured on YOUR device (median of 7 timed batches of the same ask) or the milliseconds a grown cell took; a server answer prints the microseconds ask() took on the server and the round trip this tab measured in milliseconds. The same question on the command line: node bin/brain.mjs ask dilation "hey" --provider null. The distance to the frontier is on the ladder, from the verdict files.
